summary: A standard checkbox you can check or uncheck, with a label next to it.
description:
Modern Lit-based checkbox input with a label, description, and optional icon/support link.

**A legacy XUL-style <checkbox> still exists** in the tree for older UI (toolkit/content/widgets/checkbox.js, registered as tag "checkbox"). It renders a checkbox-check image plus a checkbox-label-box (icon + label) and exposes only a simple reflected `checked` boolean, with attribute inheritance for disabled/checked/native/label/accesskey/src.

**The attrs/slots/events below describe the modern one:** moz-checkbox, which is the actively-recommended implementation.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the checkbox input control.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the checkbox input control. Defaults to "on" if unset.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: The state of the checkbox element; also controls whether the checkbox is initially rendered as checked.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the checkbox input.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the checkbox.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner input.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched when the checked state changes via user interaction.
